text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text: @gideon.sato: The first report in #inc-vtg-hartford is your post at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, which says the gate kiosks were offline at the Hartford plant. Your post says the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo's 11:03 AM message then says kiosk 1 was back and the guard checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. This channel has nothing else about the guard, so for anything more detailed, the guard's own log or the incident ticket (INC-4821) would be the place to check.

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
